title: 第012章 不会为了你惹她不开心
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

日光热烈，谢亭渝穿最简单的白衣黑裤。

身后跟的几个西装革履的男人，和他相比都沦为了陪衬。

舒楹不确定他是不是看了她一眼。

她还没反应过来，Lisa就踩着高跟迎了上去，“谢总。”

言丛挨着舒楹很近，见她脸上呆呆的，小声跟她解释道：“那是泰纳的太子爷，俪云集团据说是他姥姥家的产业。他人很低调，平常很少参与这边的事儿。”

拥有百年血统的高奢集团，旗下品牌众多，他们今天拍摄的A家香水就属于俪云。

舒楹刷到过高奢的科普帖，但她不会过度追求奢侈品，往往是有喜欢的才买，根本分不清哪几个牌子是属于同一个集团的。

会撞上谢亭渝，是她想都没想到的。

恍惚间Lisa领着谢亭渝朝他们走了过来，“这是我们A家的全球品牌代言人言丛，旁边是我们请来拍广告的导演舒楹。”

“她形象很适合我们的品牌调性，经过评估准备请她推广我们520上市的女香。”

谢亭渝顺势看向舒楹，直言道：“你确定她形象符合？”

舒楹后知后觉地意识到她的雪糕还没啃完，被谢亭渝这么上下打量让她感觉像被扒光了一样。

本能的头皮发麻。

“谢总。”人在屋檐下不得不低头，舒楹迅速咬断雪糕，抬头对他挤了个笑来。

“你们评估过没问题就行。”谢亭渝冷冷地收回目光，“是还没拍完吗？”

“在等日落。”

Lisa说完，舒楹估摸着时间差不多了，打了声招呼先去准备，“谢总，Lisa，我先忙去了。”

“言丛，你再补下妆。”

然后她背过身，走去摄像团队的位置调试镜头和确认方位。

她的摄像助理小羽八卦地凑上来，“导儿，哪来的年轻霸总啊？怎么比言丛还帅？”

“不清楚，说是俪云集团的。”舒楹摇摇头，专注地看着面前的画面。

“配置这么顶吗？我看他手上戴了个戒指，果然优质资源早就名花有主了……”

小羽没说完，舒楹先愣住了，“他戴了戒指？”

“是啊。”小羽小鸡啄米似的点头，“手和戒指都好好看。”

Page (1/3)

The sun is hot, Xie Tingyu wears the simplest white clothes and black pants.

The few men in suits and ties behind him were reduced to mere foils compared to him.

Shu Ying wasn't sure if he glanced at her.

Before she could react, Lisa stepped on her high heels and stepped forward to greet him, "Mr. Xie."

Yan Cong was very close to Shu Ying. When he saw the dull look on her face, he explained to her in a low voice: "That is the prince of Taina. The Liyun Group is said to be the property of his grandma's family. He is very low-key and seldom participates in the affairs here."

The luxury group has a century-old pedigree and has many brands. The perfume they photographed today belongs to Liyun.

Shu Ying has seen high-end luxury science posts, but she doesn’t pursue luxury goods excessively. She usually buys only what she likes, and she can’t tell which brands belong to the same group.

She never expected to run into Xie Tingyu.

In a daze, Lisa led Xie Tingyu towards them, "This is Yan Cong, the global brand spokesperson of our A family. Next to him is Shu Ying, the director we invited to shoot the commercial."

"Her image is very suitable for our brand tone. After evaluation, we are going to ask her to promote our 520 women's fragrance."

Xie Tingyu looked at Shu Ying and said bluntly: "Are you sure she fits the image?"

Shu Ying belatedly realized that she hadn't finished eating her ice cream. Being looked at by Xie Tingyu made her feel like she was being stripped naked.

Instinctively, the scalp tingles.

"Mr. Xie." People had to lower their heads under the eaves. Shu Ying quickly bit off the ice cream and raised her head to give him a smile.

"As long as there is no problem after your evaluation." Xie Tingyu withdrew his gaze coldly, "Have you not finished filming yet?"

"Waiting for sunset."

After Lisa finished speaking, Shu Ying estimated that the time was almost up, so he said hello and went to prepare first, "Mr. Xie, Lisa, I'm going to get busy first."

"Yan Cong, please put on your makeup again."

Then she turned her back and walked to the camera team's position to adjust the lens and confirm the position.

Her camera assistant Xiao Yu came up to her with gossip, "Director, where did this young boss come from? Why is he more handsome than Yan Cong?"

"I don't know, it's from the Liyun Group." Shu Ying shook his head and looked at the picture in front of him intently.

"Is the configuration so good? I saw he was wearing a ring on his hand. Sure enough, the high-quality resources have already been taken care of..."

Before Xiao Yu could finish speaking, Shu Ying was stunned, "He's wearing a ring?"

"Yes." Xiaoyu nodded like a chicken pecking at rice, "The hands and rings are very beautiful."
